description: Export the current workbook or Bridge analysis result as an Excel file. Returns the absolute path the file was written to.

target_path.description: Optional absolute file path to save the exported XLSX to. When set, the file is moved to this path and `path` is returned. When omitted, the file lands in Playwright's temp download dir (returned in `path`).

type.description: 'workbook' exports the full workbook; 'bridge' exports only the Bridge result sheet. Defaults to 'bridge'.

name: export_xlsx
